summary: Preserve trusted opt-out handling for Tock post-confirm SMS dialogs, including portal layouts whose alert copy and action controls are sibling sections.
reason: Tock can pause purchase submission behind a body-portal SMS interstitial after the confirm click. The booking flow must find a proven decline or close control across semantic and generic dialog layouts, click it without accepting SMS enrollment, and re-arm confirmation at most once when submission was swallowed.
validated_outcome: A live Tock flow declined the data-testid=sms-skip-button control and reached a confirmed receipt; DOM fixtures cover the body-portal sibling-actions shape, a role=button fallback, and agree-only refusal.
